text: {"claims": [{"id": "c0", "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S1 lists exactly the three subtypes PASSIVE, FULL, RESTART."}, {"id": "c1", "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S3", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S3 states all checkpoints initiated by sqlite3_wal_checkpoint() and the automatic mechanism are PASSIVE."}, {"id": "c2", "evidence": [], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S4 only says FULL/RESTART can only be initiated via wal_checkpoint_v2(), which does not entail every such call yields FULL/RESTART; PASSIVE is the default."}, {"id": "c3", "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S2", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S2 says a PASSIVE checkpoint might not run to completion with concurrent readers OR writers, contradicting the guarantee."}, {"id": "c4", "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P7.S1 states a checkpoint can only run to completion and reset the WAL if no other connections use the WAL file."}, {"id": "c5", "evidence": [], "check": null, "reasoning": "P7.S1 gives a necessary condition (only if), not sufficiency; it does not entail that an unused WAL is always reset."}, {"id": "c6", "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S6", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P4.S6 states the automatic checkpoint mechanism is a simple wrapper around sqlite3_wal_hook()."}, {"id": "c7", "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P3.S1 states the default checkpoint runs in the same thread as the COMMIT that pushes the WAL over its limit."}, {"id": "c8", "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S0", "rel": "refutes"}, {"sid": "P7.S3", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P2.S0 says a long-running read transaction can prevent checkpointer progress; P7.S3 says a reader prevents completion."}]}
